{{Top}}
An '''affide crystal''' was a [[Poison/Legends|poisonous]] substance. According to [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] documentation, some members of the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel Alliance]] would have an affide [[Crystal/Legends|crystal]] hidden under a [[Water/Legends|waterproof]] barrier in a false [[Tooth/Legends|tooth]]. If captured and facing interrogation via [[Torture/Legends|torture]], she or he could commit [[Death/Legends|suicide]] rather than divulge information, by prying the crystal loose with the tongue and releasing the poison.
